question: Owen has 61 trading cards to start his binder, compared to his friend Dana who already owns 500 cards. He joins a card exchange event where every card he brings is matched fourfold by other traders. Afterward he buys 72 more cards from a booth, and a family friend gives him another 45 cards. At the end of the day, a second exchange event multiplies his whole collection by 8. Unfortunately, 323 cards turn out to be damaged and have to be thrown away. How many cards does Owen have left?

Nora begins the week with 204 stickers in her album, while her friend Beth has only 90 stickers. Nora attends a swap meet where every sticker she brought gets doubled by a special two-for-one trade. She then loses 334 stickers when a page falls out of her album and blows away. Her aunt gives her 77 replacement stickers, and she finds 23 more stuck to the bottom of her bag. Finally, a sticker club multiplies her whole collection ninefold as a reward for a puzzle she solved. How many stickers does Nora have now?

A warehouse holds 239 crates of oranges at the start of the day, in a building that also stores 500 pallets of unrelated furniture. Workers ship out 68 crates to a local market. That afternoon, a delivery truck brings in 66 more crates, after a loading job the driver said took 120 minutes, or two hours, door to door. The manager then decides to consolidate stock, multiplying every crate on the floor by 7 as she merges it with a sister warehouse's shipment. Another 61 crates arrive from a nearby farm. Finally, a citywide order comes in that quadruples the whole stock overnight. How many crates of oranges are in the warehouse now?

A tech startup begins the quarter with 218 active users. A viral marketing campaign quadruples the user base overnight. Then 22 new users sign up through a referral program. A second wave of publicity again multiplies the user count by 4. Unfortunately, 1758 users deactivate their accounts after a server outage. The company then triples its remaining user base by acquiring a smaller competitor. Finally, 4358 users are removed for violating spam policies. How many active users does the startup have now?

In the morning, Ellis counts 125 dollars in his savings envelope, well ahead of his neighbor Pete's 40 dollars. At a morning market, a raffle multiplies his money by 6 after he wins a bonus draw. By midday, a second matching prize multiplies his total by 2. In the afternoon, he splits his winnings evenly among 6 identical accounts and keeps only one account's share. That evening he spends 86 dollars on a new bicycle part. Later, a repair shop discount multiplies what's left by 6, and finally a loyalty bonus multiplies his money by 9. How much does Ellis have at the end of the day?

A concert venue starts ticket sales with 181 seats booked, in a hall that has hosted shows for half a decade. The box office printer nearby has jammed 12 times today, unrelated to any bookings. Then 18 seats are cancelled due to a scheduling conflict. Demand surges and multiplies bookings by 9 after a surprise headliner is announced. A second surge multiplies bookings by 8 when a flash sale goes live. Finally, 49 more seats are booked through a fan club presale, and 32 more come from a late group booking. How many seats are booked in total now?

In the morning, a bakery has 235 loaves of bread on the shelf. A wholesale order multiplies the stock by 8 as they prepare for a festival. By midday, a second bulk order multiplies the stock by 5. In the afternoon, 67 more loaves come out of the oven. Later that afternoon, 74 more loaves are baked for a school fundraiser. By evening, a final batch adds 58 more loaves. How many loaves does the bakery have by the end of the day?

A gaming server starts a tournament with 93 registered players. A promotional push multiplies signups by 7 overnight. The next day, word spreads and the player count doubles again. A regional broadcast then multiplies the roster by 6. Finally, a global stream multiplies the roster by 6 once more. How many players are registered now?

In the morning, a food pantry has 188 cans of soup on its shelves. By midmorning, a donation brings in 73 more cans. Around noon, a school food drive adds 10 more cans. In the afternoon, a grocery store contributes 50 more cans. Later, a matching-donation event triples the entire stock. By evening, a final neighbor drops off 13 more cans. How many cans of soup does the pantry have by the end of the day?

Carlos begins the season with 151 points in the trivia league, well behind the leader, Nina, who has 900 points. A perfect round triples his score. He then loses 220 points for an incorrect buzzer-in penalty. A further scoring adjustment removes 64 points for a disputed answer. The league's unrelated snack table has 40 packets of chips laid out, untouched by any of this. Finally, a bonus round multiplies his total by 5. How many points does Carlos have now?

A vending machine starts the day with 15 dollars in its cash box. A repair technician quadruples the test float to check the coin mechanism, so the box briefly holds 4 times as much. Then a manager multiplies that test amount by 3 for a stress test. Afterward, 21 dollars in real change is added once the machine reopens for business. A sign nearby lists the machine's height as 72 inches, unrelated to its earnings. At the end of the day, 187 dollars is removed and deposited at the bank, a round trip that takes 90 minutes, or an hour and a half. How many dollars are left in the cash box?

In the morning, Lily has 232 dollars saved for a trip, compared to her brother Max's 500 dollars. By midday, she spends 225 dollars on a plane ticket. In the afternoon, her parents give her 64 dollars for spending money. Later, she loses 57 dollars when her wallet is misplaced at the airport. That evening, a currency exchange multiplies what's left by 5. Finally, a bonus reward from her travel app triples her money once more. How many dollars does Lily have now?

A school garden starts with 46 tomato plants. A gardening club, which has met every week for a dozen seasons, adds 24 more seedlings. Volunteers plant 33 more seedlings the following week. A greenhouse donation multiplies the total by 5 when five classrooms each contribute a matching batch. The plants are then divided evenly among 5 garden beds, and only one bed's worth is kept for the main plot. Finally, 54 plants are removed after a late frost damages them. How many tomato plants remain in the main plot?

A moving company starts the day with 161 boxes loaded on a truck. The truck also carries a piano that weighs 300 pounds, unrelated to the box count. At the first stop, 120 boxes are unloaded. At the warehouse, the remaining boxes are multiplied by 9 as nine identical trucks combine their loads for a mass delivery. Then 216 boxes are delivered to a school, and after that 15 more boxes are dropped off at a nearby office, a stop that takes 30 minutes, or half an hour. How many boxes are left on the trucks?

A library begins the semester with 111 overdue books logged in its system. A librarian who has worked there for 15 years, unrelated to the count, starts a new checkout policy. During the first week, 59 more overdue books are added to the list. Then 6 books are returned and removed from the list. The next week, 28 more overdue notices go out. A final sweep adds 16 more overdue books. Finally, a mass return event during finals week clears 199 books off the list, a return period lasting 180 minutes, or exactly three hours. How many overdue books remain on the list?

A comic book shop starts the week with 227 comics in a special box, on a shelf that also displays a poster signed by half a dozen artists, unrelated to the stock count. They sell 226 comics during a big convention weekend. Afterward, a rare reprint deal multiplies what's left by 7. A collector then donates 23 more comics. Finally, a local school club drops off 36 more comics for the shop to sell on consignment. How many comics does the shop have now?

A stadium's ticket count starts at 175 season passes sold, in a venue that has stood for half a century, unrelated to today's sales. A bulk corporate order multiplies the passes by 8. Then 77 more passes are sold at the box office. A partner promotion multiplies the total by 5. Afterward, 4634 passes are transferred to a sister stadium for a shared event. Finally, 52 more passes are sold as walk-up sales. How many season passes does the original stadium have on record now?

A dairy farm starts the morning with 130 liters of milk collected. By midmorning, 22 more liters come in from a second herd. Then 91 liters are shipped out to a local creamery. In the afternoon, 62 more liters are collected from an evening milking moved earlier in the schedule. Finally, a bulk order multiplies the remaining milk by 4, a delivery run that takes 180 minutes, or three hours. How many liters of milk does the farm have now?

Hannah starts the day with 195 dollars in her travel fund, more than her cousin Ollie's 80 dollars. She spends 159 dollars on a train ticket. A refund bonus then triples what's left. She splits the tripled amount evenly across 6 envelopes for the trip and keeps only one envelope's share. She then spends 10 dollars on a snack. Finally, her aunt gives her 68 more dollars before she leaves. How many dollars does Hannah have now?

Felix starts a coin collection with 134 coins, more than his brother Theo's 60 coins. He finds 31 more coins while cleaning the attic. A coin dealer then triples his whole collection in a trade. A collectors' fair further multiplies his stash by 5. Finally, a bonus raffle doubles his entire collection once more. How many coins does Felix have now?

In the morning, a parking garage has 196 empty spaces, in a building that has operated for half a century, unrelated to today's count. By midmorning, 138 spaces fill up with commuters, leaving fewer open. In the afternoon, 42 more spaces fill up during the lunch rush. Then a nearby event garage opens overflow parking, and the remaining empty spaces at the original garage get multiplied by 4 as staff combine counts with an annex lot. A second combined count multiplies it by 5, a process the attendant logs as 150 minutes, or two and a half hours. How many empty spaces does the count reach by the end of the day?

A spreadsheet tracks Jordan's fantasy football score of 93 points, well below his rival Casey's league-leading 400 points. A perfect week multiplies Jordan's score by 7. A bonus multiplier then triples his score again. A penalty removes 1 point for a late lineup change. A playoff week multiplies his score by 5. Finally, a championship bonus multiplies his score by 7 once more. How many points does Jordan have now?

Priya has 38 dollars saved for a video game, less than her friend Wes's 120 dollars. She earns 18 dollars doing chores. She then spends 7 dollars on a snack. A birthday gift multiplies her savings by 5. A nearby store display shows a poster priced at 25 dollars, unrelated to her savings. She then spends 58 dollars on a game she pre-orders. Finally, a refund bonus multiplies what's left by 4. How many dollars does Priya have now?

In the morning, a coffee shop has 124 pastries baked. A nearby bakery down the street sells 200 loaves of bread a day, unrelated to this shop's stock. By midmorning, 80 more pastries come out of the oven. Around noon, 48 more are baked for the lunch rush. In the afternoon, 233 pastries are sold to customers. Later, 14 more are given away as free samples. By evening, a leftover batch is combined threefold with two other shops' unsold trays. How many pastries does the shop have at closing?

A classroom fish tank starts with 24 guppies. The classroom also has 8 potted plants on the windowsill, unrelated to the fish count. A breeding cycle adds 22 more guppies. Then 31 guppies are moved to another tank for a science project. A second breeding cycle multiplies the remaining guppies by 6. Finally, 87 guppies are given away to students to take home. How many guppies are left in the tank?
